title: Support tickets
subtitle: Messages from the website contact form and the student apps. Triage, assign, reply and close them here.
searchPh: Search number, subject, name, phone or email…
emptyHint: Try another tab or clear the filters.
emptyOpenHint: There are no open tickets right now.
replyHintStudent: The student is notified in the app (in-app + push).
replyHintContact: This request came from the website. The reply is saved on the ticket; answer the visitor using the email or phone above.
contactFormNote: Sent from the public contact form; the visitor has no student account linked.
deleteBody: The ticket and its conversation are removed permanently. Use this for spam or test tickets; resolve real tickets instead.
